text_blocks.snippet: Metabolic encephalopathy symptoms can include confusion, memory loss, personality changes, and difficulty concentrating or thinking clearly. These symptoms can range from mild confusion to coma and may be temporary or permanent depending on the cause and severity. Other potential symptoms include drowsiness, sleep disturbances, and in severe cases, seizures.
